adamantine-scale-mail.acquire: Forged from a Scale Mail Mould and Mithral Ore
adamantine-scale-mail.effect: Adamantine Scale Mail is a very rare Medium Armour that reduces all incoming damage by 1 and sends attackers Reeling. In addition, attacks cannot land Critical Hits on the user.
adamantine-scale-mail.name: Adamantine Scale Mail

adamantine-splint-armour.acquire: Forged from a Splint Mould and Mithral Ore
adamantine-splint-armour.effect: Adamantine Splint Armour is a very rare Heavy Armour that reduces all incoming damage by 2 and sends attackers Reeling. In addition, attacks can't land critical hits on the wearer.
adamantine-splint-armour.name: Adamantine Splint Armour

amulet-of-misty-step.acquire: In a Gilded chest next to the bed behind Polma in Gut's private chambers
amulet-of-misty-step.effect: Amulet of Misty Step is an uncommon amulet that grants its wearer the Misty Step spell on a short rest cooldown.
amulet-of-misty-step.name: Amulet of Misty Step

boots-of-stormy-clamour.acquire: Sold by Omeluum after completing the quest Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite
boots-of-stormy-clamour.effect: Boots of Stormy Clamour are an uncommon pair of Boots that inflict the Reverberation condition on a creature when afflicting it with another condition.
boots-of-stormy-clamour.name: Boots of Stormy Clamour

boots-of-striding.effect: The Boots of Striding are an uncommon pair of Boots that grants the wearer a burst of speed whenever they begin concentrating on a spell.
boots-of-striding.name: Boots of Striding

boots-of-uninhibited-kushigo.acquire: Carried by Prelate Lir'i'c, as entering Act Three
boots-of-uninhibited-kushigo.effect: The Boots of Uninhibited Kushigo are a rare pair of Boots that add the wearer's Wisdom modifier to their Unarmed Strike damage.
boots-of-uninhibited-kushigo.name: Boots of Uninhibited Kushigo

bow-of-awareness.acquire: Sold by Roah Moonglow, to the left beyond the sanctum entrance
bow-of-awareness.effect: Bow of Awareness is an uncommon +1 Shortbow that boosts the wielder's Initiative.
bow-of-awareness.name: Bow of Awareness

bracers-of-defence.acquire: In a gilded chest in the secret cellar area of the Apothecary, beneath the Blighted Village
bracers-of-defence.effect: Bracers of Defence are a rare pair of Gloves which increase the wearer's Armour Class by 2 when unarmoured and not holding a shield.
bracers-of-defence.name: Bracers of Defence

breastplate-1.acquire: On crate near Dammon in the The Hollow
breastplate-1.effect: Breastplate +1 is an uncommon Medium Armour that reduces Piercing damage.
breastplate-1.name: Breastplate +1

broodmother-s-revenge.acquire: Carried by Kagha in the Emerald Grove
broodmother-s-revenge.effect: The Broodmother's Revenge is an uncommon Amulet. It coats the wearer's weapon in poison for 2 turns whenever they are healed.
broodmother-s-revenge.name: Broodmother's Revenge

caustic-band.acquire: Sold by Derryth Bonecloak in the Underdark
caustic-band.effect: Caustic Band is an uncommon Ring that grants the wearer 2 Acid damage with weapon attacks.
caustic-band.name: Caustic Band

crusher-s-ring.effect: Crusher's Ring is an uncommon Ring which grants additional speed to the wearer.
crusher-s-ring.name: Crusher's Ring

diadem-of-arcane-synergy.acquire: Carried by Ardent Jhe'rezath in the Inquisitor's Chamber
diadem-of-arcane-synergy.effect: The Diadem of Arcane Synergy is a rare circlet that grants Arcane Synergy when the wearer inflicts a condition.
diadem-of-arcane-synergy.name: Diadem of Arcane Synergy

disintegrating-night-walkers.effect: The Disintegrating Night Walkers are story-related Boots which grant their wearer immunity to various surface effects, and also allows them to cast Misty Step once per Short Rest.
disintegrating-night-walkers.name: Disintegrating Night Walkers

elixir-of-hill-giant-strength.acquire: • Sold by various merchants throughout the game, including: • Araj Oblodra at Moonrise Towers • Auntie Ethel in the Druid Grove or the Riverside Teahouse is unique in that she always sells a stack of 3 per Long Rest or level-up • Derryth Bonecloak in the Myconid Colony (uncommonly, she may sell up t.
elixir-of-hill-giant-strength.effect: Elixir of Hill Giant Strength is an uncommon elixir. It increases Strength when consumed.
elixir-of-hill-giant-strength.name: Elixir of Hill Giant Strength

everburn-blade.acquire: Carried by Commander Zhalk at the helm of the Nautiloid during the Prologue.
everburn-blade.effect: Everburn Blade is an uncommon greatsword that deals additional ⁠⁠Fire damage.
everburn-blade.name: Everburn Blade

flame-blade.effect: Flame Blade is a level 2 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to summon a fiery scimitar in their free hand that sheds bright light. Casters can make a melee weapon attack with the blade to deal Fire damage to enemies.
flame-blade.name: Flame Blade

gloves-of-archery.effect: Gloves of Archery are an uncommon pair of Gloves that grant the wearer Proficiency with Longbows and Shortbows, as well as +2 damage with ranged weapon attacks.
gloves-of-archery.name: Gloves of Archery

gloves-of-belligerent-skies.acquire: In an elegant chest in the Inquisitor's Chamber, along the southern wall of the room, on the western side
gloves-of-belligerent-skies.effect: The Gloves of Belligerent Skies are an uncommon pair of Gloves that inflict Reverberation when the wearer deals ⁠Thunder, ⁠Lightning or ⁠Radiant damage.
gloves-of-belligerent-skies.name: Gloves of Belligerent Skies

gloves-of-cinder-and-sizzle.acquire: Sold by Lady Esther, north-east of the Trielta Crags waypoint
gloves-of-cinder-and-sizzle.effect: The Gloves of Cinder and Sizzle are a rare pair of Gloves that add Fire damage to the wearer's unarmed attacks and the ability to cast Scorching Ray once per Long Rest.
gloves-of-cinder-and-sizzle.name: Gloves of Cinder and Sizzle

gloves-of-dexterity.effect: The Gloves of Dexterity are a very rare pair of gloves that give a character 18 Dexterity and increase their Attack Rolls by 1.
gloves-of-dexterity.name: Gloves of Dexterity

gloves-of-the-growling-underdog.acquire: In Dror Ragzlin's treasure crates behind the locked iron gate
gloves-of-the-growling-underdog.effect: The Gloves of the Growling Underdog are an uncommon pair of Gloves which grant the wearer Advantage on their melee attack rolls while surrounded by 2 or more enemies.
gloves-of-the-growling-underdog.name: Gloves of the Growling Underdog

hand-crossbow-1.acquire: Sold by Derryth Bonecloak in the Underdark
hand-crossbow-1.effect: Hand Crossbow +1 is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Hand Crossbows family of weapons. It is a martial ranged weapon wielded in one hand. It's a light weapon that anyone can dual-wield without special training.
hand-crossbow-1.name: Hand Crossbow +1

haste-helm.effect: The Haste Helm is a rare helmet that grants the wearer a burst of speed at the start of combat.
haste-helm.name: Haste Helm

hellrider-s-pride.acquire: Carried by Zevlor and can be looted from him, stolen, or earned as a reward for Kill Kagha or Investigate Kagha
hellrider-s-pride.effect: Hellrider's Pride are an uncommon pair of Gloves that grant creatures healed by the wearer resistance to the physical damage of weapon attacks.[See: Bugs]
hellrider-s-pride.name: Hellrider's Pride

holy-lance-helm.acquire: In a painted chest, accessible from the top level
holy-lance-helm.effect: A Holy Lance Helm is an uncommon Helmet that potentially deals radiant damage to creatures that attack the wearer.
holy-lance-helm.name: Holy Lance Helm

knife-of-the-undermountain-king.effect: The Knife of the Undermountain King is a very rare +2 shortsword which increases the frequency of scoring Critical Hits and grants Advantage against obscured enemies.
knife-of-the-undermountain-king.name: Knife of the Undermountain King

luminous-armour.acquire: in a locked and trapped opulent chest
luminous-armour.effect: Luminous Armour is an uncommon Medium Armour that allows the wearer to cause radiant shockwaves whenever they deal Radiant damage.
luminous-armour.name: Luminous Armour

melf-s-first-staff.effect: The Melf's First Staff is an uncommon +1 Quarterstaff that improves Spell Save DC and Spell Attack Rolls, and allows the wearer to cast Melf's Acid Arrow.
melf-s-first-staff.name: Melf's First Staff

pearl-of-power-amulet.acquire: Sold by Omeluum after completing the quest Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite
pearl-of-power-amulet.effect: The Pearl of Power Amulet is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wielder to restore a spell slot of 3rd level or lower once per Long Rest.
pearl-of-power-amulet.name: Pearl of Power Amulet

phalar-aluve.effect: Phalar Aluve is a rare +1 Longsword that can be made to Sing or Shriek, granting nearby allies or enemies a bonus to Attack Rolls or damage rolls, depending on the choice.
phalar-aluve.name: Phalar Aluve

psychic-spark.effect: Psychic Spark is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to cast a stronger version of Magic Missile.
psychic-spark.name: Psychic Spark

ring-of-arcane-synergy.effect: Ring of Arcane Synergy is a rare Ring. It grants Arcane Synergy when the wearer deals damage with a cantrip.
ring-of-arcane-synergy.name: Ring of Arcane Synergy

ring-of-protection.acquire: Rewarded by Mol for completing the quest Steal the Sacred Idol in the Emerald Grove
ring-of-protection.effect: The Ring of Protection is a rare Ring that grants the wearer a bonus to Armour Class and Saving Throws.
ring-of-protection.name: Ring of Protection

safeguard-shield.acquire: Sold by Dammon in the Emerald Grove
safeguard-shield.effect: The Safeguard Shield is an uncommon Shield that grants you Saving Throws +1
safeguard-shield.name: Safeguard Shield

sentient-amulet.effect: Sentient Amulet is an amulet that comes in two varieties:
sentient-amulet.name: Sentient Amulet

spidersilk-armour.effect: Spidersilk Armour is a rare Light Armour that aids the wearer with Stealth checks and Constitution Saving Throws.
spidersilk-armour.name: Spidersilk Armour

strange-conduit-ring.acquire: Inside an elegant chest in the Inquisitor's Chamber
strange-conduit-ring.effect: The Strange Conduit Ring is a uncommon Ring that grants additional Psychic damage to the wearer's weapon while Concentrating.
strange-conduit-ring.name: Strange Conduit Ring

svartlebee-s-woundseeker.effect: Svartlebee's Woundseeker is an uncommon +1 greatsword that grants its wielder bonus to Attack Rolls against already damaged creatures.
svartlebee-s-woundseeker.name: Svartlebee's Woundseeker

swiresy-shoes.effect: The Swiresy Shoes are a pair of rare Boots that improve Jumping distance and Acrobatics skill.
swiresy-shoes.name: Swiresy Shoes

sword-of-justice.acquire: Carried by Anders in Toll House, or rewarded by him for killing Karlach in Hunt the Devil
sword-of-justice.effect: Sword of Justice is an uncommon +1 greatsword that grants its wielder the Tyr's Protection spell.
sword-of-justice.name: Sword of Justice

the-graceful-cloth.acquire: Sold by Lady Esther, north-east of the Trielta Crags waypoint
the-graceful-cloth.effect: The Graceful Cloth is a rare piece of Clothing which gives its wearer +2 Dexterity and the Cat's Grace condition. It also boosts their Dexterity Saving Throws and jump distance.
the-graceful-cloth.name: The Graceful Cloth

the-protecty-sparkswall.acquire: In a gilded chest at the end of the trapped bridge
the-protecty-sparkswall.effect: The Protecty Sparkswall is a rare Clothing that increases the wearer's defences while they have Lightning Charges and grants a +1 bonus to their Spell Save DC.
the-protecty-sparkswall.name: The Protecty Sparkswall

the-shadespell-circlet.acquire: Sold by Omeluum after completing the quest Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite
the-shadespell-circlet.effect: The Shadespell Circlet is an uncommon Helmet that grants a bonus to Spell Save DC when the wearer is obscured in shadow.
the-shadespell-circlet.name: The Shadespell Circlet

the-sparkle-hands.acquire: in a wooden chest at the base of the giant tree stump in the Sunlit Wetlands
the-sparkle-hands.effect: The Sparkle Hands are a pair of rare Gloves that grant Lightning Charges on unarmed attacks and provide Advantage against metal constructs and armoured foes while charged.
the-sparkle-hands.name: The Sparkle Hands

the-spellsparkler.acquire: Rewarded by Counsellor Florrick for rescuing her from the burning inn during the quest Rescue the Grand Duke.
the-spellsparkler.effect: The Spellsparkler is a rare Quarterstaff that allows the wielder to generate Lightning Charges upon dealing damage with spells.
the-spellsparkler.name: The Spellsparkler

the-whispering-promise.effect: The Whispering Promise is an uncommon Ring that grants a bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws to creatures healed by the wearer.
the-whispering-promise.name: The Whispering Promise

titanstring-bow.acquire: Sold by Brem after completing the quest Find the Missing Shipment
titanstring-bow.effect: Titanstring Bow is a rare +1 Longbow that allows its wielder to add their Strength Modifier to damage dealt with this weapon.
titanstring-bow.name: Titanstring Bow

torch.effect: A Torch can be used as a Light Source or as an improvised club. It can be wielded as a simple melee weapon in one hand. The torch is a light weapon that anyone can dual wield without special training.
torch.name: Torch

unseen-menace.effect: Unseen Menace is a rare + 1 Pike which increases critical hit chance and grants Advantage as long as the wielder keeps connecting hits.
unseen-menace.name: Unseen Menace

warped-headband-of-intellect.effect: The Warped Headband of Intellect is an uncommon Circlet that raises the wearer's Intelligence to 17.
warped-headband-of-intellect.name: Warped Headband of Intellect
